Resolves #19097
Related: #15252

The film opens on the tear-outs. `fiveBeatFilm.mjs` keeps its eight scene ids and plays them as cold open (3 s, a breath of the living room) → morph (Metrics leaves the window, a vessel is born mid-gesture and retires on re-entry) → the committed tear-out (Metrics stays out) → second window (Commits converts while dragged, straight out of `right-bottom-tabs`, and docks into the vessel) → the stack comes home → the drop-zone showcase (Metrics, the travelled pane, to the feed's band) → perspectives with undo/redo → signature (the hundred-thousand-row scroll, every window closed, the feed still growing); 97 s of budget. The first vessel is born at ~5 s instead of after 26 s. The header records the format decision as the dialogue (lines bound to scene/cue ids on the epic), the unit spec pins the new order and budget, the film-tour witness reads its receipts in the new order, and the README names the sequence.

Evidence: L2 (headless e2e over the seat's own Neural Link bridge, `NEO_NL_PORT` per #19066) → L2 required (#19097's AC-1 as restated after review R1: this leaf delivers the screenplay and its headless replay). Residual: the headed 1/1 witness at the merged head, transferred to #15252's take acceptance (`[L3-deferred — operator handoff needed]`, owner Mnemosyne), Residual-Owner: #15252.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the pre-commit lint-staged hooks ran (secrets, whitespace, shorthand, jsdoc-types, ticket-archaeology, block-alignment, parse, derived-domain, fixed-sleeps).

## Deltas from ticket
- The ticket's draft put the committed tear-out first and the morph second on Commits; the replay falsified it — a re-entry re-arms only on a strip that still exists, and a single-tab group is removed when its tab leaves. The morph stays first, both window beats on Metrics out of the two-tab right-top group; the operator's "open with the tear-outs" is met by the three-second cold open (ticket body corrected in place).
- The showcase drags Metrics, not Commits: after the return Commits is the right band's last tab, inside the executor's 48 px window-edge margin.
- The conversion takes Commits from `right-bottom-tabs` (the showcase no longer pre-moves it), which the replay proved works for a committed conversion from a single-tab source.

## Test Evidence
- `WorkstationFilmTourNL.spec.mjs` headless on the seat's own bridge: replay 1 (draft order) 1/3 with the morph failing to re-arm; replay 2 (morph first) 22-beat run stopped at the showcase's margin refusal; replay 3 at the committed shape 3/3 in 53 s; two further runs 3/3 each (logs kept host-local).
- `unit/apps/workstation`: 152/152 before and after the reorder.
- Not in CI: the film witness is a Neural Link spec (deselected by the e2e CI filter); the unit spec is CI-covered.
